summary: Alaska Silver Corp. filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026 covering Items 1.01, 5.02 and 9.01. The registrant, a British Columbia-incorporated silver explorer, disclosed a Ninth Amendment to a Promissory Note originally issued March 31, 2021 by subsidiary Alaska Silver USA Corp to acquire Piek Incorporated for $3,698,000; the note pays 3.5% annually and the maturity was extended from July 1, 2027 to July 1, 2028. Separately, a new consulting agreement with Piek Exploration LLC, controlled by Chief Exploration Officer Joe Piekenbrock, replaced a $3,000 monthly fee with $200 per hour effective January 1, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or change-of-control terms are stated. This is a routine related-party debt-extension and compensation filing, not a special situation; watch for dilution or liquidity signals from further note amendments.
